content: README first-paragraph extraction heuristics. RST spec (docutils restructuredtext.html#sections, verified): section title = single text line with underline (and optional overline) of ONE repeated non-alphanumeric printable ASCII char beginning in column 1, extending at least as far as the title's right edge; recommended chars = - ` : . ' " ~ ^ _ * + #; blank line after title optional; transitions = 4+ repeated punctuation chars with blank lines around. Paragraphs: 'blocks of left-aligned text... blank lines separate paragraphs'. Markdown: image syntax ![...](...) may be wrapped [![...](...)](...) (badge); TOC = bullet links - [...] / * [...] or numbered 1. [...]; setext headings (title line + ===/--- underline) are the markdown equivalent of rst underline headings — one skip rule handles both. Heuristic recommendation: skip blank lines; skip image-only lines (contains ![, and stripping all [...](...) pairs leaves empty); skip TOC link-list lines (leading '- [' / '* [' / numbered 'N. ['); skip underline lines (>=3 identical chars from = - ~ ^ _ * + # ' " `) AND the preceding non-blank line (heading pair); then take first consecutive non-blank block as the paragraph. Websearch only corroborated markdown syntax basics (badges, setext) — heuristic thresholds are agent discretion per 11-CONTEXT.md.
